summary: A Yes vote changes the city business license tax so it is calculated on gross receipts instead of number of employees, raising about $600,000 per year for general city services until ended by voters.

tax.text: A yes vote on Measure R would replace Albany’s employee-based business license tax with a gross-receipts tax and raise an estimated $600,000 annually for general city services.
tax.quote: Raises an estimated $600,000 a year for general city services, with funds that stay local.

tax.text: A No vote would reject the business-license-tax change projected to raise an additional $600,000 annually for Albany general services.
tax.quote: Revenue collected from the tax, providing an estimated additional $600,000 annually, would support Albany general services
